test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Now, I was shining from top to toe and felt proud of my form.

B. Finally, I was ready to leave the factory for my new home.

C. Then the painter set about rubbing me vigorously and polishing me.

D. A busy carpenter at last gave finishing touches to me.
solution:
The correct answer is 'DCAB'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some __grammatical or contextual__ connections between them. Also, the first sentence of a passage is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. 

__
 
• Sentence D is the independent sentence and simply talks about how the subject (me) got finishing touches from a busy carpenter. 
 
• So, sentence D is the first sentence after rearrangement. Sentence D implies that the subject is most probably a piece of furniture. 
 
• Sentence C describes the subject get rubbed and polished by a painter. Hence, C follows D.__
 
• Sentence A which explains the final appearance of the subject should come after sentence C, to maintain continuity on the topic. 
 
• Sentence B is the concluding statement of the passage as it provides what the subject was finally ready for. 

Thus, the correct order after rearrangement is option 3 i.e. DCAB.

So, the correct paragraph is :*(****D) A busy carpenter at last gave finishing touches to me. (C) Then the painter set about rubbing me vigorously and polishing me. (A) Now, I was shining from top to toe and felt proud of my form. (B) Finally, I was ready to leave the factory for my new home.***
